title: understanding the dom tree
question: What is the DOM?

answer: JavaScript's live representation of the HTML page as a tree of objects

title: understanding the dom tree
question: What can JavaScript do with the DOM?

answer: Read modify add and remove elements on the page

answer: A tree with parent child and sibling relationships

answer: body

answer: H1
